cases.title: Add new bookmark into a specific location
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark can be successfully added into a specific designated location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Delete bookmark from bookmarks file and access points
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark is properly deleted from the bookmarks file and no longer displayed from all access points.

cases.title: Add and delete bookmark from personal toolbar
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be successfully added to and deleted from the personal toolbar.

cases.title: Insert new bookmark folder into bookmarks hierarchy
cases.description: Verify that a new bookmark folder can be successfully inserted into a specific location within the bookmarks hierarchy.

cases.title: Launch bookmark in browser window
cases.description: Verify that double-clicking on a bookmark causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Validate default bookmarks packaged with browser
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks within the default bookmarks file that is packaged with the browser are valid links.

cases.title: Verify bookmark item changes are saved without loss of integrity
cases.description: Verify that changes made to a bookmark item are successfully saved without any loss of item integrity.

cases.title: Delete Bookmarks Folder
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks folder can be successfully deleted.

cases.title: Add and delete bookmarks separator
cases.description: Verify that a bookmarks separator can be successfully added and deleted.

cases.title: Save Bookmark Changes Over Restart and Crash
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks changes are successfully saved and persisted over browser restart and crash.

cases.title: View properties execution for bookmarks, folders, and separators negative test
cases.description: Verify that view properties execution fails or is not possible negatively for bookmarks, folders, and separators.

cases.title: Inline renaming of bookmarks without properties dialog
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks can be renamed inline directly without having to use the bookmarks properties dialog.

cases.title: Find Bookmark Using User-Defined Custom Keyword
cases.description: Verify that a bookmark can be found using a user-defined custom keyword.

cases.title: Sort and reverse-sort bookmarks per column
cases.description: Verify that bookmarks are sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize Bookmark Columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be resized to show or hide more of the entries.

cases.title: Show and hide bookmark columns
cases.description: Verify that bookmark columns can be successfully showed and hidden.

cases.title: Delete multiple bookmarks at one time
cases.description: Verify that several bookmarks can be successfully deleted at the same time.

cases.title: Prevent dropping a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or its immediate child
cases.description: Verify that it is not possible to drop a bookmark item onto itself, its immediate parent, or its immediate child.

opinions.feedback: The test cases correspond one-to-one with the requirements. However, requirements R-003, R-009, and R-014 each describe multiple distinct operations (adding and deleting, or sorting and reverse-sorting) but currently have only a single test case covering them. Please expand the test suite to include distinct scenarios for each operation described in these requirements.

analysis.analysis: Unit: firefox_bookmarks. Revised analysis based on feedback: R-001 has two distinct behaviors (adding a new bookmark and placing it into a specific location). R-002 has two distinct behaviors (deletion from bookmarks file and removal from all access points display). R-003 has two distinct behaviors (addition to the personal toolbar and deletion from the personal toolbar). R-004 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-005 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-006 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-007 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-008 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-009 has two distinct behaviors (adding bookmarks separators and deleting bookmarks separators). R-010 has two distinct behaviors (saving changes over restart and saving changes over crash). R-011 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion with an explicit negative test path (Abnormal/Error scenario). R-012 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-013 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-014 has two distinct behaviors (sorting per column and reverse-sorting per column). R-015 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-016 has two distinct behaviors (showing column and hiding column). R-017 describes a single straightforward acceptance criterion (Normal scenario). R-018 has three distinct abnormal behaviors based on explicit parameters (dropping a bookmark onto itself, onto its immediate parent, and onto its immediate child).
